transfer.runtime_target: current 32-bit value read from SS stack

cpu_contract.execution: Each claim is local physical x86-32 behavior if that instruction is reached and completes without fault. No live CPU state, segment descriptor, cell, provider, or callee body was queried.
cpu_contract.stack_attributes: Each implicit stack ESP equation requires SS to have a 32-bit stack-address attribute at that particular instruction. Program language x86:LE:32 does not prove current SS. After every opaque call, SS/DS and all segment state and attributes are unconstrained again. With a 16-bit SS stack-address attribute the stated implicit-stack ESP formulas are not asserted. Explicit ADD ESP,12 is 32-bit register arithmetic independent of the SS stack-address attribute.
cpu_contract.current_memory_and_aliases: Memory expressions use the current segment and memory at the named instruction execution time. A PUSH memory operand is read before its stack store, using the pre-decrement ESP for [ESP+4]. Potential aliasing does not justify reusing an earlier cell or entry-stack value. No memory validity, disjointness, frame identity, argument identity, or preservation is assumed.
cpu_contract.opaque_return_rule: All four callees are opaque and none is proved to return. At each conditional continuation, every register including EAX/ESI/EBP/ESP, flags, segments/descriptors and memory is newly unconstrained. Symbols Q1..Q4 name only ESP at that particular return; no relation to entry ESP or earlier Q is asserted.
cpu_contract.entry_09: For current entry ESP=T, E8 at BFBA09 writes BFBA0E to current SS:[T-4], sets ESP=T-4, and transfers to numeric C05B68. This local CALL preserves other general registers and arithmetic flags; the callee has no established preservation.
cpu_contract.continuation_0E_12: If control resumes at BFBA0E with ESP=Q1, read V1 as the current dword at SS:[Q1+4] using the pre-push ESP. PUSH stores V1 to current SS:[Q1-4] and leaves ESP=Q1-4. E8 at BFBA12 writes BFBA17 to SS:[Q1-8] and transfers to numeric C059A8 with ESP=Q1-8. V1 is not authenticated as the original caller argument.
cpu_contract.continuation_17_1D: If control resumes at BFBA17 with ESP=Q2, read V2 as the current dword at DS:[00E15580] before the PUSH stack store. PUSH writes V2 to current SS:[Q2-4] and leaves ESP=Q2-4. E8 at BFBA1D writes BFBA22 to SS:[Q2-8] and transfers to numeric C04FDE with ESP=Q2-8. The absolute cell address is encoded; its current contents, type and provider identity are unqueried.
cpu_contract.continuation_22_27: If control resumes at BFBA22 with ESP=Q3 and EAX=A3, PUSH imm32 writes the 32-bit value 255 to SS:[Q3-4] and leaves ESP=Q3-4. The encoding is 68 FF000000, not a sign-extended imm8 -1. CALL EAX at BFBA27 uses the current A3 as its unresolved runtime target, writes BFBA29 to SS:[Q3-8], and transfers with ESP=Q3-8. It is register-indirect, not an extra memory dereference. These local instructions preserve other general registers including EBP and arithmetic flags.
cpu_contract.continuation_29_2C: If control resumes at BFBA29 with ESP=Q4, ADD ESP,sign_extend(0x0C) sets R=(Q4+12) mod 2^32 and ESP=R; it performs no memory access and requires no SS stack-size assumption. It preserves other general registers and sets the arithmetic flags below. RET at BFBA2C then reads its unknown next EIP from current SS:[R] and, only with current SS stack-address size 32, leaves ESP=R+4 mod 2^32. RET preserves the ADD arithmetic flags. Neither the return target nor a restored original caller stack is authenticated.
cpu_contract.accepted_caller_prefix: The accepted ENTRY packet records a caller zero edge reaching BFBA09 with EAX=ESI=0 and ESP=T under that earlier local path and its stack qualification. Only the entry E8 preserves those values into C05B68 before that opaque callee executes. No zero value, prior stack slot, flags, segment attribute or other state is propagated through the first or any later opaque return.
cpu_contract.scope: No service named __amsg_exit, argument count/type, calling convention, provider, nonreturn, original ABI, Source implementation, game behavior or runtime equivalence is established.

Root_strict_core_replay.pure_replay_design: No Capstone import or construction; actual decoder output is retained data compared against independent physical fields. All archived producers are inert. Strong guard records every denied event and requires denied=[].
